llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文将不确定性量化应用于增材制造材料性能预测，方法可迁移至植入物力学性能的代理建模。
llm.why_not_core: No FEA surrogate, no implant biomechanics, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 增材制造中材料性能预测的不确定性量化需求
summary_zh.method: 采用概率方法量化工艺参数对材料性能预测的不确定性
summary_zh.result: 展示了不确定性量化在预测材料性能中的有效性
summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟案例验证不确定性量化方法

summary_en.motivation: To quantify uncertainty in predicting material properties during additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: Probabilistic methods are employed to propagate uncertainty from process parameters to material property predictions.
summary_en.result: The study demonstrates the effectiveness of uncertainty quantification in improving prediction reliability.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation case studies.
